etymology: Blend of "receipts", the slang for evidence, + "bomb"
trigger: A claim has just been made that the other person could probably support, if anyone asked one question at a time.
tell: Forty screenshots, no captions, no order, and a demand to "do your own research" attached to the last one.
counter: Ask for the single best screenshot and read it. The move depends on nobody reading all of them.

confused_with.tell: The gallopologist invents the claims; the receiptbomber buries real ones. Both win on volume.

senses: The move of answering an argument with an unreadable quantity of genuine documentation, so that the reply costs more to check than the claim cost to make.
It works because evidence has an optimum and the bomb goes well past it. A single document can be read and answered; forty cannot, and the unanswered pile looks exactly like a refutation.
example: *"He replied with forty-one screenshots, three of them duplicates and a link to a folder - a **receiptbomb** that took an hour to find the one paragraph that mattered in."*
